methodologyNotes: This dataset covers twelve miter saw models spanning the budget-to-professional spectrum, including corded sliding-compound saws, cordless platforms, and one worm-drive design. Specifications were re-verified against manufacturer product pages (DeWalt, Makita, Milwaukee, Metabo HPT, Bosch, Festool, Skil, Delta, Genesis, Ryobi), major tool retailers (Coastal Tool, Acme Tools, Tool Nut, OakTree Supply, Home Depot, Walmart, Lowe's), and independent reviews (Pro Tool Reviews, ToolGuyd, Tool Box Buzz). Bevel and miter ranges are stated in degrees (e.g., "48 L/48 R"); crosscut capacity is the maximum board dimension at 90 miter and 0 bevel unless otherwise noted; weight is net (saw only, no battery unless specified); laser_or_shadow_guide is a boolean true when any integrated cut-line system (laser, LED shadow line, XPS system) is present. Prices reflect current typical US retail price as of accessedAt 2026-06-20; where a model is discontinued or street price diverges materially from list, the priceNote explains. Adversarial fact-check corrections (June 2026): DWS779 price lowered to street/discontinued level, DWS780 price lowered toward typical street, Ryobi TSS103 raised to Home Depot regular price, Festool Kapex release corrected to 2019 REB model, DCS361B cut-line terminology corrected.

products.name: DeWalt DWS779 12-Inch Sliding Compound Miter Saw
products.priceNote: Discontinued; typical street ~$399-$449 (was $599 original MSRP), stock-dependent
products.provenance: Blade size (12 in), bevel 0-48 L/R, 15A/3800 RPM, crosscut 2x14 at 90, and 56 lb weight confirmed on DeWalt official product page (verified live, marked Discontinued) and Lowe's listing. Miter range 50 L/60 R confirmed. No integrated cut-line system (distinguishes from DWS780). Release year 2017 per iFixit TYPE 20 (2017) designation. PRICE CORRECTED 599->399: $599 was the original MSRP; the saw is now discontinued and sells ~$399 at Lowe's / ~$449 on Amazon (per 731 Woodworks and ToolGuyd 2026 deal coverage).

products.priceNote: List price ~$669; typical street $449-$499, frequently on sale
products.provenance: Blade size (12 in), 15A/3800 RPM, crosscut ~13.75 in (2x14) at 90, bevel 49 L/49 R, miter 50 L/60 R, and XPS LED shadow cut-line system confirmed on DeWalt official page and Hubbard Supply / Mallory spec tables. Introduced September 2011 (DeWalt 2011 media event; iFixit TYPE 1 2011). PRICE CORRECTED 649->499: manufacturer list ~$669, but typical street price runs $449-$499 (Amazon $449, Lowe's/Acme ~$399-$499 per 2026 deal coverage); $499 used as conservative typical retail. Weight ~56 lb (retailer figures vary 52-61 lb across configurations).
